info.name: Sanad Care Homes
info.description: Care-home facility owner onboarding, anonymous public discovery/detail, inventory/availability, HC-TASK-032 booking lifecycle, authored HC-034 stay operations, and authored HC-023 room transfers and future-maintenance amendments. Admin operational APIs belong to the Sanad Admin collection and docs/admin. Examples require the disposable Development fixture; they are not runtime-verified in this collection.

variable.value: The recorded arrival does not match our evidence.

item.name: 00. Public discovery (anonymous)
item.description: Read-only public discovery. Every request explicitly uses noauth despite the collection-level bearer auth. Use only an approved eligible disposable fixture; no setup or database reset is included. Eligibility requires the approved revision and the latest revision-scoped operating license, registration, health certificate, and civil defense document to be usable on the current Cairo date. Ratings/top-10 is deferred to HC-TASK-041.

request.description: Returns page, pageSize, totalCount, and ID-ascending summaries. page must be at least 1 and pageSize must be 1..50. Public fields omit contact details, private documents, owner/review data, ratings, availability/capacity, room instances/beds, and resident clinical data. startingFromMonthlyPriceEgp is the minimum non-archived room-type price, including zero; it is null when no active room type exists.

exec: const body = pm.response.json(); pm.test('page shape is present', () => { pm.expect(body.page).to.eql(1); pm.expect(body.pageSize).to.eql(10); pm.expect(body.totalCount).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(body.items).to.be.an('array'); });

pm.test('public response omits private fields', () => { const raw = pm.response.text(); ['contactName','contactPhone','contactEmail','privateStorageKey','documents','ownerUserId','reviewHistory'].forEach(field => pm.expect(raw).not.to.include(field)); });

request.description: Invalid pagination returns 400 with code CareHomes.Discovery.InvalidQuery.

Use careHomeDiscoveryId from a guarded disposable fixture. Detail includes the approved address, admission conditions, amenities, medical services, and active room-type cards; it does not expose private or resident data. Optional expectedCareHomeEnglishName and expectedStartingFromMonthlyPriceEgp variables enable exact fixture assertions.

exec: const body = pm.response.json(); pm.test('detail shape is present', () => { pm.expect(body.summary.id).to.eql(pm.variables.get('careHomeDiscoveryId')); pm.expect(body.summary.arabicName).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(body.summary.englishName).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(body.address).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(body.roomTypes).to.be.an('array'); });
const expectedName = pm.variables.get('expectedCareHomeEnglishName'); if (expectedName) pm.test('fixture name matches', () => pm.expect(body.summary.englishName).to.eql(expectedName));

const expectedPrice = pm.variables.get('expectedStartingFromMonthlyPriceEgp'); if (expectedPrice) pm.test('fixture minimum price matches', () => pm.expect(String(body.summary.startingFromMonthlyPriceEgp)).to.eql(String(expectedPrice)));

pm.test('detail omits private fields', () => { const raw = pm.response.text(); ['contactName','contactPhone','contactEmail','privateStorageKey','documents','ownerUserId','reviewHistory','ratings','capacity'].forEach(field => pm.expect(raw).not.to.include(field)); });

request.description: Use a GUID that is not an eligible facility. Unknown and ineligible IDs intentionally map to the same 404 code CareHomes.Discovery.NotFound.

exec: pm.test('unknown or ineligible detail is hidden', () => pm.response.to.have.status(404));

item.name: 02. Submission
item.description: Authored submission contract. Run after the owner has saved all required bilingual fields and uploaded all four private documents; the current disposable fixture has not yet been executed for this delta.

request.description: Owner-only state change. Validates the bilingual profile and four required documents, freezes the submitted revision, and enters PendingReview. Expected errors: 409 CareHomes.Facility.InvalidSubmission for incomplete requirements or 409 CareHomes.Facility.Conflict for stale/non-editable versions.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { pm.test('application is pending review', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().status).to.eql(2)); pm.collectionVariables.set('careHomeFacilityVersion', pm.response.json().version); }

item.name: 05. Care-home bookings (HC-032, authored)
item.description: Source-authored HC-TASK-032 booking lifecycle examples. Requires the disposable Development fixture variables below and an effective Finance rule. These requests have not been runtime-verified; do not point them at production or reset a database to make them runnable.

request.description: FamilyAccess. Lists the caller family's bookings newest first.

Creates one calendar month with a 15-minute unpaid hold. Start date must be at least 24 hours from checkout in Cairo time. Success is 200; validation/arrival/capacity/configuration errors are mapped by the API.
Family scoped detail. Cross-family and unknown IDs return 404 CareHomes.Bookings.NotFound.
Card/Wallet Paymob intent. Repeating an existing intent returns the same intent; expired/non-payable bookings return 409 CareHomes.Bookings.InvalidState.
CareHomeOwnerAccess. Lists paid requests for the owner's facility only.
CareHomeOwnerAccess. Accept moves PaidAwaitingDecision to Accepted. Reject requires a reason, moves to RefundPending, and initiates a full refund when a transaction exists.
Anonymous HTTP endpoint with valid Paymob HMAC. A chb_ merchant reference dispatches to the Care-home aggregate; duplicate same-transaction callbacks are idempotent.

item.name: 06. Stay operations (HC-034, authored)
item.description: Source-authored HC-034 room/bed assignment, actual facility check-in/out, Family confirmation, Family-submitted dispute, owner operational readback, and Admin dispute resolution. Requires an accepted booking and disposable fixture IDs. Check-out without Family confirmation opens a case immediately; a Family dispute requires a booking owned by that Family with facility check-in recorded. These examples are authored, not runtime evidence.

request.description: CareHomeOwnerAccess. Shared stays require a bed; Private/Suite stays must send bedId as null and reserve the whole room. The room must match the booking facility and room type. Invalid allocation returns 400 CareHomes.Bookings.InvalidAssignment; an occupied resource returns 409 CareHomes.Bookings.AssignmentConflict.
CareHomeOwnerAccess. Records the server UTC actual check-in for an accepted, assigned booking. Repeated or invalid lifecycle transitions return 409 CareHomes.Bookings.InvalidState.

FamilyAccess. The booking must belong to the caller's Family and have an active facility check-in. Cross-family/unknown IDs return 404 CareHomes.Bookings.NotFound; before-check-in or repeated confirmation returns 409 CareHomes.Bookings.InvalidState.

FamilyAccess. The booking must belong to the caller's Family and have a facility-recorded check-in. The reason is trimmed and must contain 1-2000 characters. A valid first submission returns one Open Admin case with familyReason; a repeat returns the same open case without replacing the reason. Facility actualCheckInOnUtc and actualCheckOutOnUtc remain unchanged. Anonymous is 401, wrong-family/unknown is 404 CareHomes.CheckInDispute.NotFound, missing check-in is 409 CareHomes.CheckInDispute.InvalidState, and invalid reason is 400 CareHomes.CheckInDispute.InvalidReason. This request is authored only and requires an eligible disposable booking.
CareHomeOwnerAccess. Returns assigned room/bed, actual facility timestamps and actors, and Family confirmation timestamp/actor.

CareHomeOwnerAccess. Records server UTC actual check-out. If Family confirmation is missing, opens one Open Admin case immediately; no timeout is used. Repeated/invalid transitions return 409 CareHomes.Bookings.InvalidState.
CareHomesOperationalAdmin (SuperAdmin or SupportAdmin only; ContentAdmin is denied). Lists cases newest first. Provide an authorized admin token before running.

CareHomesOperationalAdmin (SuperAdmin or SupportAdmin only; ContentAdmin is denied). Evidence, reason and a UTC effective check-in are required. Missing case is 404 CareHomes.CheckInDispute.NotFound; repeated/invalid resolution is 409 CareHomes.CheckInDispute.InvalidState. Supply an authorized admin token before running.

item.name: 07. Room transfers and future maintenance (HC-023, authored)
item.description: Requires separate pre-existing disposable fixtures: accepted bookings assigned to Private and Suite rooms with same-type destination rooms; an overlapping accepted booking; a future maintenance block; and an Owner JWT. Transfer effective dates must be Cairo-local, non-backdated, and within the stay. No fixture setup, DB reset, or provider request is included.

request.description: Same-type Private room transfer; Suite follows the equivalent contract. Success preserves booking room type and price/payment snapshots, appends transfer history and queues Family in-app/email notifications. A future effective date leaves the operational current assignment unchanged until that Cairo date.

exec: pm.test('Private room transfer keeps bed null', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().assignedBedId).to.be.null);

request.description: Same-type Suite room transfer; the assigned resource is the whole room and bedId must be null. Provide a separate accepted Suite booking and active same-type destination room.

item.name: Read transfer history and current assignment

request.description: Owner operational readback includes current effective room/bed plus append-only assignmentHistory with prior/new resources, Cairo effectiveDate and actorUserId.

exec: const history = pm.response.json().assignmentHistory; pm.test('transfer entry includes actor and destination', () => { const move = history.find(x => x.toRoomId === pm.collectionVariables.get('hc023PrivateDestinationRoomId')); pm.expect(move).to.exist; pm.expect(move.actorUserId).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(move.effectiveDate).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('hc023TransferEffectiveDate')); });

item.name: Reject repeated transfer on same Cairo date

request.description: The transfer date is already present in this booking's assignment history; expected 409 CareHomes.Bookings.TransferConflict.
An overlapping accepted stay owns this destination; expected 409 CareHomes.Bookings.AssignmentConflict.

item.name: Reject a bed on Suite transfer

request.description: Private and Suite transfers reserve the whole room and reject a supplied bed with 400 CareHomes.Bookings.InvalidAssignment.

exec: pm.test('Suite bed shape is rejected', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(400); pm.expect(pm.response.json().code).to.eql('CareHomes.Bookings.InvalidAssignment'); });

request.description: Only a block and amended start date strictly after today's Cairo date can be amended. Occupancy, overlaps and expected facility version are revalidated.

item.name: Cancel future maintenance and verify retained state

request.description: Cancellation is retained (not hard-deleted), records actor/time, and removes the block from availability immediately.

exec: const block = pm.response.json().maintenance.find(x => x.id === pm.collectionVariables.get('hc023MaintenanceId')); pm.test('cancelled block remains readable', () => { pm.expect(block.isCancelled).to.eql(true); pm.expect(block.cancelledBy).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(block.cancelledOnUtc).to.be.a('string'); });

item.name: 08. Cancellation and refunds (HC-035, authored)
item.description: Requires separate disposable bookings in the indicated states. Family cancellation before recorded check-in refunds totalAmount; after recorded check-in it refunds 50%. Owner cancellation of an accepted stay refunds the full amount. Admin recovery requires a failed or externally completed refund. No requests reset or seed the database.

request.description: Returns full refund amount, including after facility approval but before recorded check-in.
Returns 50% of totalAmount after actual facility check-in is recorded; checkout must not yet be recorded.
Accepted stay cancellation returns a full refund and records the reason.
Only a persisted failed refund is retryable. Local runtime requires a disposable failed-refund fixture; no provider call outside the Development stub is authorized.
Records completion only; this endpoint does not call Paymob. SuperAdmin/SupportAdmin only.
